title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Evidence:

ForceField | Anti Knockback | RapidFire

ForceField:

Your view was locked on the nearest player and you were hitting really fast. You can see that on the blood particles.

Anti Knockback:

Right as I zoomed in you got shot by another player, but you didn't got knocked back.

RapidFire:

Well, on that I'm not entirely sure if it was RapidFire. You basically shot an arrow without pulling back your bow (Every second shot)

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing the evidence, I don't think there is any wrong doing. The alleged Forcefield is difficult to see, therefore you'll be given the benefit of the doubt. Again, the AntiKnockback is a very small piece of evidence, and you can't ban for not taking Knockback once. Again, you'll be given the benefit of the doubt. With the Rapid Fire, I can cleary see your bow being pulled back. Therefore it's not RapidFire.

You could have had an easy appeal, however you decided to ban evade. This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
